provenance.benchmark_scope: EnterpriseRAG-Bench v1.0.0 core questions.jsonl; Confluence-only retrieval slice; 64 official compatible questions
provenance.selection_rule: official original row order; source_types exactly [confluence]; expected_doc_ids non-empty; every qrel resolves against frozen corpus
provenance.selection_scope: EnterpriseRAG-Bench v1.0.0 core questions; all 64 Confluence-only qrel-compatible rows
provenance.scoring: dot product over locally L2-normalized vectors; RRF k=60
provenance.normalization: local L2 normalization; Ollama owns tokenization and pooling
provenance.latency_boundary: one timed arm invocation per case, including retrieval only

config.verdict_rule: Recall@10 primary and MRR@20 secondary; no top-10 regression; one strict gain; ties favor simplicity; conflicts are insufficient

query_contract.task_description: Given a web search query, retrieve relevant passages that answer the query
